    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ArcherTower
    Basic single-target ranged tower with low cost and moderate stats.
    AssetManager
    Singleton image repository that preloads and serves game asset textures.
    BatEnemy
    Fast and fragile bat enemy used for quick path pressure.
    BigSlimeEnemy
    Tankier slime variant with higher health and lower speed.
    CannonTower
    Heavy tower with higher damage and range than the basic archer.
    CrossbowTower
    Fast-firing ranged tower with extended attack range.
    Damageable
    Represents an entity that can receive damage.
    DamageText
    Floating combat text that rises and fades over a short lifetime.
    DamageTextTest
     
    Decoration
    Decorative map object placed on a specific grid tile.
    DemonEnemy
    High-threat demon enemy with strong stats and high reward.
    Enemy
    Base enemy model used by all enemy variants in the game.
    EnemyTest
     
    GameManager
    Central gameplay coordinator for combat, economy, spawning, and win/lose state.
    GameManager.TowerType
    Available tower types that can be selected for placement.
    GameManagerTest
     
    GameMap
    Mutable map model containing grid tiles, build decorations, and computed path waypoints.
    GameMapTest
     
    GameView
    JavaFX gameplay canvas that renders map entities and handles in-game pointer input.
    GoblinEnemy
    Mobile goblin enemy with moderate health and reward.
    IceWizardTower
    Wizard tower variant with high range and slow firing cadence.
    KingSlimeEnemy
    Boss-like slime enemy with very high health and heavy base damage.
    Launcher
    Thin entry point that delegates startup to the JavaFX application class.
    LevelLoader
    Loads map grids from classpath text resources.
    LevelLoaderTest
     
    LightningWizardTower
    Long-range wizard tower with high cost and strong projectile damage.
    Main
    Main JavaFX application entry for the tower defense game.
    MainMenu
    Builds and controls the main menu scene shown before gameplay starts.
    PathGenerator
    Generates randomized playable path layouts for tower-defense maps.
    PathGeneratorTest
     
    PoisonWizardTower
    Wizard tower variant using poison-themed projectile visuals.
    Projectile
    Projectile fired by towers toward a specific enemy target.
    ProjectileTest
     
    SkeletonEnemy
    Mid-tier skeleton enemy with balanced movement and durability.
    SlimeEnemy
    Basic early-game slime enemy with balanced default stats.
    SoundManager
    Centralized audio controller for sound effects, background music, and mute state.
    Theme
    Visual environment themes used to style the map.
    Tower
    Base tower type for all combat towers.
    TowerTest
     
    UIUtils
    Utility helpers for creating and updating commonly styled JavaFX UI controls.
    Upgradable
    Represents an entity that can be upgraded.
    Waypoint
    A path node in world coordinates that enemies move toward.
    ZombieEnemy
    Slow and sturdy zombie enemy that deals moderate base damage.
